How to use the muscle guide

Each muscle page explains what the muscle does, lists the best exercises by equipment, gives a sensible weekly volume range, and shows which workout splits train it and how often. Start with the muscle you want to improve, pick two or three exercises you can perform well, then add them to a training day in the workout planner.

The same muscle groups power the rest of SplitsWorkout: every exercise in the exercise library lists its primary and secondary muscles, and the planner's coverage chart adds those up across your week so you can spot muscles you are under- or over-training.

Not sure how to spread muscles across the week? Compare the workout splits or let the Split Finder suggest one.
